text:
support_jess: Heads-up — Dedicated customer (cust-318) reporting sudden throughput drop on pool rwd-dedicated-us-west-2-7. 429s spiking and p95 token latency jumped to ~1.2s starting ~09:08 UTC. No deploy on our side. /cc @eng_runtime_lead @sam_ops

eng_runtime_lead: Can you paste sample request IDs and any short logs? Also did autoscaler fire around that time?

support_jess: Sample req ids: req_abc123, req_def456. Logs show repeated: `enqueue timeout` from continuous-batcher and a lot of `max_batch_tokens exceeded` + `scheduler backpressure`. Repro: run load with seq_len=512, concurrency=30, sustained token/s burst of ~5k. Pasting small log excerpt:
```
[09:07:58] worker-12 continuous-batcher: enqueue timeout after 120ms (pending=24)
[09:07:58] worker-12 scheduler: rejected request req_abc123 reason=max_batch_tokens_exceeded
[09:08:01] worker-12 kv-cache: hit=0 prefill=small_batch
```

sam_ops: infra-bot shows autoscaler scaled DOWN at 08:59 and back UP at 09:15 — that window aligns with the drop. Looks like scale-down removed capacity while traffic was spiky. Checking min_replicas and burst policy now.

maria_ml: Also seeing traces: small-batch fraction jumped to ~68% -> lots of microbatches (8-16 tokens) reducing packing efficiency. Could be noisy tenant churning short requests or auth retries. Any per-tenant token caps/config?

support_jess: Customer says one integration retried quickly after some 401s earlier — they pushed many small requests to the same worker. They had no per-tenant token limit configured.

eng_runtime_lead: Quick mitigations to validate hypothesis:
- bump min_replicas to 3 for that pool
- set a soft per-tenant token rate cap for the customer (e.g., 10k tok/s)
- temporarily increase max_batch_tokens to 4096 and enable packing_bias=aggressive
If metrics improve, we open autoscaler bug.

sam_ops: I'll kick a canary config change and watch. Filing an issue for autoscaler: RWD-ISSUE-5123 (suspected: scale-down ignores in-flight prefill tokens).

support_jess: Customer agreed to canary. Also they sent traces showing many quick 401 -> retry loops; that might explain the small-batch spike.

maria_ml: Longer-term scheduler tuning: increase prefill_timeout to 200ms, raise scheduler quantum to 40ms, and enforce per-tenant queue cap. That should reduce microburst sensitivity and improve pack ratios. I'll draft a config PR for defaults.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling config change applied to rwd-dedicated-us-west-2-7 by sam_ops — min_replicas=3, packing_bias=aggressive, max_batch_tokens=4096 (start: 09:22 UTC).

eng_runtime_lead: Post-change quick check: small-batch fraction dropped from 68% -> 22%, p95 latency back to ~210ms, 429s returned to baseline. Keep monitor on for 2h.

support_jess: :thumbsup: Customer satisfied for now. Closing immediate escalation. Will follow up with RWD-ISSUE-5123 remediation and default scheduler config PR. Thanks all.
